changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7. MIDI, a machine on hidden slot 42, plays an external synth from a Rytm track: notes, chords, pitch bend, mod wheel, pressure and six CC lanes, all lockable.

Source-only export compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/midi-engine in Modwerk's pinned toolchain (m68k-elf GCC 16.2.0, binutils 2.47). Not byte-identical to the author's unit-tested ME17 build (GCC 12.2); since ME17 the source changed only by the machine:42 claim in build.json.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
